Switch on control voltage for

Measure filling time as a standard 
 value for the setting of the timing relay K2 on the instrument panel, figure 3

Check refilling time as on the time relay (K2) 
 fig. 3, "on" delay for refilling time monitoring. ( t set 
 approx. 2 times the refilling time after O-C-O )

Check SF6 pressure in the pole 
 column and check the pressure of air in the compressed air receiver before 
 switching.

Carry out test switching operations: 
 - 10 C-O-switchings at one minute intervals
 - Including 2 O-switchings with the manual emergency valve.

Checking the pressure drop when switching as the following steps:
 - Produce operating pressure. 10 bar
 - Separate refilling valve from voltage or close shutoff valves 
 (371/372). Figure 4
 - Operate the circuit breaker electrically.
 - Read off values on manometer (375) five minutes later. Figure 4
 At 20 OC the difference is about 
 0.6 bar for opening, and about 0.3 bar for closing the breaker.
 - Markedly increased pressure drops point to a fault in the 
 pneumatic system.
Check the mechanical On, OFF position indicators.
